title: AgentDefinitionV1
description: ZeroWall Science Agent definition schema v1. Describes an Agent's role, capabilities, permission policy, and model bindings.

name.description: Human-readable agent name (e.g., 'General Purpose', 'Research Assistant'). English only; localized names belong in metadata.locale.

role.description: Agent role determines default model binding and permission policy

description.description: Short description of the agent's purpose and capabilities

tools.description: Whether the agent can call tools (MCP servers, skills)

reasoning.description: Whether the agent supports extended reasoning (o1/o3 style)

multimodal.description: Whether the agent accepts image/file inputs

codeExecution.description: Whether the agent can execute code in kernels

webAccess.description: Whether the agent can browse the web

mode.description: Permission mode: off (no execution), approve (prompt), full (auto-approve)

allowedTools.description: Tool patterns this agent is allowed to use (glob, e.g., 'pubmed/*', 'compute/slurm')

blockedTools.description: Tool patterns this agent is explicitly blocked from using

maxConcurrentCalls.description: Maximum concurrent tool calls per turn

modelBinding.description: Default model binding for this agent (can be overridden per session)

fallback.description: Fallback model when primary is unavailable

systemPrompt.description: System prompt injected before every conversation (optional)

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata (display hints, locale-specific fields, etc.)
